summary: Franco-Nevada Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements and management discussion and analysis for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports routine revenue breakdowns across streams, royalties, and geographic segments, including its Labrador Iron Ore Royalty Corporation interest, along with standard credit facility and equity investment disclosures. No transaction, shareholder action, or corporate event of a special-situations nature is identified; the report is a conventional periodic disclosure by a Canadian issuer furnished to the SEC under the multijurisdictional disclosure system.
